title: Claude Project That Scores Your Business Idea Out of 10
description:
A Claude Project that scores your business idea out of 10 and gives a verdict: build it, change it, or drop it.

Full guide: https://shorturl.at/TO7YA

Most AI tells you your idea is good. This one runs on a scoring rubric instead. You describe your idea, Claude asks six questions to close the gaps, then researches direct competitors, their pricing, who raised funding and when, and which startups already shut down trying the same thing.

The output is short on purpose. One verdict line, an idea score out of 10, a separate evidence score so you know when it's guessing, the strongest alternative version of your idea, and the cheapest test you can run in seven days.

How do you validate a business idea using Claude?

Comment IDEA and I'll send you the setup guide.

YouTube @TechSober, Instagram @techsober10, techsobergroups@gmail.com
